13

bas dgag pa/ don dam/ chos rnams rang bzhin gyis stong par gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal bas dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang / tha snyad/ skyon spong gi lan no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/rang bzhin gyis grub kyang dpyad bzod du mi 'gyur pa'i skyon spong dang / 'di la/ lan des skyon spong mi nus par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ dngos dang / de dag dpyad na med par mtshungs kyang yod med mi mtshungs par bstan pa dang / des na/ 'khrul ngor yod pa tha snyad du yod pa'i don ma yin par bshad pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ 'khrul ngor yod med thams cad mi mtshungs par bstan pa dang /de dag 'khrul tshul mi mtshungs pa'i lan dgag pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ thog med nas brgyud pa'i 'khrul ngor yod na kun rdzob tu yod pa'i lan mi rigs pa dang / 'khrul ba/ tsam sgras gcad bya ngos gzung ba dang / de lta/ tha snyad kyi dbang gis yod par 'grub tshul bstan pa'o/ /de 'dra/ bzhi pa chos rnams rang bzhin gyis stong par gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal bas dgag pa la gnyis/ rang mtshan las gzhan gyis stong pa gnas lugs mthar thug tu mi 'thad par bstan pa dang / chos rnams/ gzhan stong mi 'thad pa'i rgyu mtshan no/ /dgag gzhi/ gsum pa bkag pa'i rang bzhin med pa bsgrub bya yin min bsam pa la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / 'o na/ dgag pa'i rnam gzhag bshad pa dang / rang bzhin med pa rtags kyi bsgrub byar bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ dgag pa'i rnam gzhag spyir bshad pa dang / de la/ chos gzhan 'phel tshul gyi don bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /kha cig gsum pa rang ba zhin med pa rtags kyi bsgrub byar bshad pa la gnyis/ rtags dang rjes dpag gis rang bzhin med pa sgrub par bstan pa dang / de la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ gzhan lugs dgag pa dang /'di la/ rang lugs gzhag pa'o/ /des na/ gnyis pa de la rtsod pa spang ba la gnyis/ lung don bshad de rtsod pa spang ba dang / gal te/ dogs pa skye tshul mi 'thad par bstan pa'o/ /dogs pa/ gsum pa rang nyid gang gi rjes su 'brang bstan cing mjug bsdu ba 'a/ gnyis/ rang nyid gang gi rjes su 'brang bstan pa dang / da ni/ gzhung gi mjug bsdu ba'o/ /de ltar/ gsum pa bstan bcos ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul dge bsngo sbyar byang dang bcas pa la gsum/ 'gran zla med pa'i bstan bcos 'di ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul/ bstan bcos brtsams pa las byung ba'i dge ba ji ltar bsngos pa'i tshul/ tshul gnyis /bstan bcos khyad par can de mdzad pa po phun sum tshogs pas ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul lo/ /ces 'don/dang po la bzhi/ sbyor tshul phun sum tshogs pas ji ltar sbyar ba'i tshul/ rgyal ba'i/ sbyar ba'i bstan bcos kyi che ba bstan pa/ legs bshad/ drang nges kyi don rtogs pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ rlabs chen/drangs nges rtogs 'dod pas bstan bcos 'di la 'jug par gdams pa'o/ /de ltar/ 14

smras pa/ 'dir 'bad legs byas zla ba'i zegs ma yid kyi bum par bsags pa las/ /klu sgrub 'jam dpal snying po'i thugs bcud zab gsang gtam gyis phyogs kun 'gengs/ /'khrul med yang dag lta ba'i bdud rtsis bde chen lam gyi srog bsos te/ /'gro kun 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sa la bdag nyid gcig pus 'god gyur cig /ces drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa bstan bcos legs par bshad pa'i snyi nga po'i bsdus don drang nges lta ba'i mig 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ klu sgrub snying po'i rang srol 'dzin pa la thugs bskyed kyi dpung ba stobs su rdzogs pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang dpal ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi bzhin/ dbu mar mos pa/ dbyangs can dges pa'i rdo rjes lo mtshams kyi khong bris pa'i yi ge ba ni 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung don la spobs pa rab tu dge ba mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog blo gros rgya mtshos bgyis pas rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying po'i rang lugasadus kyi mthar yang gsal bar byed nus par gyur cig/ // swa sti/ mdo smad dan tig nye 'khor mthu ba dgon/ /bkra shis chos sder par 'di bskrun pa'i mthus/ /bla ma'i zhabs brtan rgyal ba'i lugs bzang rgyas/ /'brel thogs kun kyang sham bha lar skye shogatho/

smras pa/ 'dir 'bad legs byas zla ba'i zegs ma yid kyi bum par bsags pa las/ /klu sgrub 'jam dpal snying po'i thugs bcud zab gsang gtam gyis phyogs kun 'gengs/ /'khrul med yang dag lta ba'i bdud rtsis bde chen lam gyi srog bsos te/ /'gro kun 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sa la bdag nyid gcig pus 'god gyur cig /ces drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par 'byed pa bstan bcos legs par bshad pa'i snyi nga po'i bsdus don drang nges lta ba'i mig 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ klu sgrub snying po'i rang srol 'dzin pa la thugs bskyed kyi dpung ba stobs su rdzogs pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang dpal ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi bzhin/ dbu mar mos pa/ dbyangs can dges pa'i rdo rjes lo mtshams kyi khong bris pa'i yi ge ba ni 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung don la spobs pa rab tu dge ba mkhas pa'i dbang po dkon mchog blo gros rgya mtshos bgyis pas rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying po'i rang lugasadus kyi mthar yang gsal bar byed nus par gyur cig/ // swa sti/ mdo smad dan tig nye 'khor mthu ba dgon/ /bkra shis chos sder par 'di bskrun pa'i mthus/ /bla ma'i zhabs brtan rgyal ba'i lugs bzang rgyas/ /'brel thogs kun kyang sham bha lar skye shogatho/

drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par phye ba gsal bar byed pa legs bshad snying po'i don mtha' dag rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad snying po'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//dregs pa'i gtsug gi me tog mdangs ldan pa/ /zhabs mthil ga pur 'dzum pa'i dra ba la/ /btud pas zab don sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas su/ /sgrub mkhas thub dbang lha mi'i mchod sdong rgyal/ /che ba'i blo can gang gis mkhyen rab mtha'/ /mi rnyed kun bzang spyod pa'i 'od stong can/ /lam 'di ji bzhin rtogs nas 'doms pa la/ /zla bral dpal ldan bla mas dus kun skyongs/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor utpal sngo ba'i mdangs/ /rnam 'byed me long dwangs pa'i gdong ba la/ /rgyan du 'char ba'i dngos grub stsol ba'i lha/ /'jam dpal sangs rgyas kun gyi bla mar gus/ /rgya chen spyod pa'i gtam gyi ku mu da/ /thugs bskyed zur phud ngos la rab rtsen pas/ /kun mkhyen shākya seng ge'i chos kyi khrir/ /dbang bsgyur mi pham bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dpal stug lam bzang yongs kyi rtser son pa/ /zab mo'i rten 'byung rig pa'i rgyal rnga yis/ /mthar 'dzin gdug pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig byed pa/ /klu sgrub sangs rgyas gnyis pa rgyal gyur cig /dga' ldan zhing gi me tog ma rnyings pa/ /rang gi gtsug tor rtse la mngon drangs pas/ /sngon med legs bshad gtam gyi mchod sbyin mkhan/ /rnam rig shing rta'i srol 'byed thogs med mchod/ /klu sgrub srol la dbang bsgyur 'phags pa lha/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo grub brnyes sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan zhi ba 'tsho sogs mu tig gi/ /do shal sa la grol ba'i mched por dad/ /khyad par mtha' bral gnas lugs 'khrul med du/ /'tshol ba'i skal ba bzang por bka' drin gyi/ /cod pan rin thang med pa'i khur /sbyin pa/ /zla grags srid pa'i gdung sel gtsug tu bkur/ /thogs med lam srol u dusba ra'i 'dzum/ / skyong mkhas dbyig gnyen blo gros brtan pa'i zhabs/ /phyogs glang chos grags la sogs 'phags yul na/ /rigs pa skyong ba'i paṇa chen rim byon bsngags/ /zab gsang legs bshad gtam gyi snying po seng chen rtsen 16

drang ba dang nges pa'i don rnam par phye ba gsal bar byed pa legs bshad snying po'i don mtha' dag rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos legs bshad snying po'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//dregs pa'i gtsug gi me tog mdangs ldan pa/ /zhabs mthil ga pur 'dzum pa'i dra ba la/ /btud pas zab don sbrang rtsi'i 'byung gnas su/ /sgrub mkhas thub dbang lha mi'i mchod sdong rgyal/ /che ba'i blo can gang gis mkhyen rab mtha'/ /mi rnyed kun bzang spyod pa'i 'od stong can/ /lam 'di ji bzhin rtogs nas 'doms pa la/ /zla bral dpal ldan bla mas dus kun skyongs/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor utpal sngo ba'i mdangs/ /rnam 'byed me long dwangs pa'i gdong ba la/ /rgyan du 'char ba'i dngos grub stsol ba'i lha/ /'jam dpal sangs rgyas kun gyi bla mar gus/ /rgya chen spyod pa'i gtam gyi ku mu da/ /thugs bskyed zur phud ngos la rab rtsen pas/ /kun mkhyen shākya seng ge'i chos kyi khrir/ /dbang bsgyur mi pham bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /dpal stug lam bzang yongs kyi rtser son pa/ /zab mo'i rten 'byung rig pa'i rgyal rnga yis/ /mthar 'dzin gdug pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'jig byed pa/ /klu sgrub sangs rgyas gnyis pa rgyal gyur cig /dga' ldan zhing gi me tog ma rnyings pa/ /rang gi gtsug tor rtse la mngon drangs pas/ /sngon med legs bshad gtam gyi mchod sbyin mkhan/ /rnam rig shing rta'i srol 'byed thogs med mchod/ /klu sgrub srol la dbang bsgyur 'phags pa lha/ /dpal ldan dpa' bo grub brnyes sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /legs ldan zhi ba 'tsho sogs mu tig gi/ /do shal sa la grol ba'i mched por dad/ /khyad par mtha' bral gnas lugs 'khrul med du/ /'tshol ba'i skal ba bzang por bka' drin gyi/ /cod pan rin thang med pa'i khur /sbyin pa/ /zla grags srid pa'i gdung sel gtsug tu bkur/ /thogs med lam srol u dusba ra'i 'dzum/ / skyong mkhas dbyig gnyen blo gros brtan pa'i zhabs/ /phyogs glang chos grags la sogs 'phags yul na/ /rigs pa skyong ba'i paṇa chen rim byon bsngags/ /zab gsang legs bshad gtam gyi snying po seng chen rtsen 16

pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /nor gyi blo gros yangs pa'i mtha' la rgyal dbang bden par smra ba yi/ /mdzad bzang zla ba 'bum gyi bzhin ras ji bzhin ston pa'i grags pa can/ /gangs ljongs tshad ma'i ston pa gang la tshul 'di rtogs pa'i dngos grub zhu/ /de yi bstan la gang gi sor rtog gi/ /ye shes 'dzam gling rgyan gyi paṇa chen du/ /yongs shar gser zhun cod pan 'chang ba yi/ /ston pa gnyis pa dge legs dpal bzang rgyal/ /mdo smad nor bu 'dzin pa'i byad yangs por/ /sgrub bstan bdud las rgyal ba'i ba dan dkar/ /sgreng mkhas rong ston skal ldan rgya mtsho yi/ /sku 'phreng zhing 'di'i ston pa nyid phyir mchod/ /'jam dpal dbyangs dang mnyam pa'i mkhyen rab 'phrul/ /'phags bod gzhung lugs che la bkod tsam gyis/ /gtsug lag mtha' dag rang tshugs mi bzod pa/ /bdag gi mes po bzhad pa'i rdo rjes skyongs/ /bdag la dge mtshan gser gyi gar bu ni/ /mos 'dun bzhin du gang las 'byung ba'i zhing / /dus 'dir thub bstan 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso/ /gang zhig rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bor bsten/ /mi pham zab gsang gdams pa'i rgya mtsho gang gi thugs la dga' ldan pa'i/ /snying po las byung sngon med gtam gyis kun tu rmongs pa'i khol bo bdag /mkhas mang padma dkar po'i lcug phran rnam par bzhad pa'i gral ring bor/ /ci yang 'dren pa'i byed po gcig pur dad gus lang tsho ngom pas gus/ /rgyal ba phyogs kyi kun dga' ches//zab don utpal gzhon nu yis/ /skal bzang mig dkyus ring bo can/ /yid la sos kyi dus ston byin/ /gang tshe blo bzang shing rta bas/ /mkhyen gter gsung gi padmo'i bcud/ /bzhes pa'i gsung gsang kai ta nas/ /rnyog pa bkrungs pa'i chu gter spel/ /de las legs par bshad pa yi/ /snying po gcig tu bsdus pa'i bcud/ /gang zhig rgol ba ngan pa la/ /'jigs pa sbyin pa'i 'phrul 'khor nyid/ /thar pa mya ngan med pa'i grong / /ji bzhin mtshon 'dod re ba'i mig /mtho bar 'degs la yang dag gnad/ /gsal ba'i sgron me gcig pur gyur/ /gang zhig don la ma rmongs pa'i/ /blo gros nam mkha'i mthongs phye ste/ /rjod pa dag pa'i 'od tshogs kyis/ /dge legs sbyin pa zad ma gyur/ /'jam mgon 'jam dpal snying po yi//lcags mda' lcags kyi gzhu'o zhes/ /'gugs 'dod 'gugs dka'i gtam tsam gyis/ /zhum zhing zhum par gyur pa'ang mang / /gang tshe bdag gi cod pan gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi zur phud la/ /zhabs sen 'od ris rnam bkra ba/ /li khri'i snye ma'i bcud la bzhes/ /thar 'dod slu ba'i chom po ni/ /'di zhes 'jig ltar gsod sdigs kyis/ /legs bshad 'phrul gyi gzhu mo la/ /man ngag nyag phran sbyar te 'phangs/ /'khor ba chu yi srin po'i grong / /bgrod pa'i zam stegs btsugs pa las/ /rang blo gser gyi yol go dang / /'tsham pa'i bdud rtsi shas gcig thob/ /nags kyi dpal mo'i skra tshogs 'dzum par me tog snye ma'i 'phyang 'phrul la/ /rkang pas snun pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang ldan mgrin pa'i za zi sbreng ba ba'in/ /khyab bdag chos kyi 17

padma mchog gi gsung gsang bcud kyis myos pa las/ /sngon med legs par bshad pa'i sgra dbyangs thar 'dod yid kyi dus ston bya//rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi drang ba dang nges pa'i don ma lus pa rnam par 'byed pa/ shing rta chen po mtha' dag gi bzhed pa ma 'dres par gsal bar phye ba/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa ji snyed pa'i snying po yul dang yul can gyi de kho na nyid legs par gsal ba/ dus gsum gyi 'phags pa ma lus pa'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i gzhung lam nye bar mtshon pa/ tshad mar gyur pa'i paṇa grub mtha' dag gi legs bshad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag gi gsang bas nye bar 'khyud pa/ phas kyi rgol ba mtha' dag spa bkong nas skal ba bzang po rnams yang dag pa'i lam la 'dren pa/ bstan pa la log par rtog pa'i dri ma phra mo nas bsal te 'khrul ba med pa'i lam srol brtan por 'dzugs pa/ sngon med pa'i legs bshad kyi phung po 'jigs pa med pa'i seng ge'i sgra rnam par bsgrags pa/ bdag cag gi rnam 'dren bla ma chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha ba chen po bstan pa 'di la bstan pa'i bdag po las kyang lhag pa'i mdzad pa dang bka' drin gyi khur lci ba gang gis mdzad pa'i drang nges kyi bstan bcos legs bshad snying po zhes bya ba'i sngon med pa'i chos kyi gtam chen po de nyid kyi don 'chad pa la gnyis/ bstan bcos 'di mdzad tshul sogs bshad pa'i gleng bslang ba dang / skabs su bab pa'i bstan bcos kyi don dngos bshad pa'o/ / 18

rtsa ba'i sa bcad dang po/drang nges legs bshad snying po mdzad tshul sogs bshad pa'i gleng bslang ba/dang po bstan bcos 'di mdzad tshul sogs bshad pa'i gleng bslang ba ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis dang por thugs bskyed pa dang / bar du tshogs bsags pa dang / mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa thams cad 'gro ba rnams 'khor ba phra rags kyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i phyir chos kyi sgra dbyangs spyir sgrogs pa dang /khyad par du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo la sogs pa'i skabs su zab mo de kho na nyid kyi chos kyi rnga chen po 'jigs pa med nga/ra rdung ba'i ched du mdzad pa yin la/ sher phyin yongs gtad kyi skabs su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mdo sde rin po che kun dga' bo la ji ltar gtad pa dang tshul mtshungs par zab mo'i lam gyi rim pa mtha' dag rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gtad nas nyams pa med par skyong ba'i khur phog pa ltar rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter gyis kyang srol de nyid zhing 'dir tshul bzhin du bskyangs pa'i sgo nas zab mo'i lam gyi khur thams cad bzhes par mdzad cing / 'phags bod kyi yul du bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu byon pa phal mo ches bstan pa'i snying po yang dag pa'i lta ba 'di la thos bsam sgom gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba rgya cher mdzad do/ /de yang 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha ba chen po de nyid bstan pa'i srol ga thams cad gzhi nas nyams pa'i dus su zhing 'dir byon te dang por thos bsam/bar du sgom sgrub/ tha mar 'chad rtsod rtsom pa gang mdzad kyang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi don tshig spyi tsam la ma lus par/ da lta las dang po ba nyid nas rang gi rgyud la bskor nas nyams su blangs pas chog pa'i tshul/ lam gyi ngo bo/ grangs nges/ go rim sogs thams cad shing rta chen po rnams kyi lam srol dang mthun pa zhig med du mi rung bar gzigs nas bla ma yi dam la gsol ba drag tu btab cing / gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa mtha' dag la zhib tu dpyod pa rgyun mi 'chad du mdzad pas/ thog mar bshes gnyen bsten pa nas 'go brtsams te/ mthar zhi gnas dang lhag mthong la bslab tshul gyi bar theg pa che chung thun mong dang / theg chen thun mong ma yin 19

pa'i lam spyi dang / de'i steng du sngags kyi thabs mkhas kyi khyad par thun mong ma yin pa rnams snon pa btab nas nyams su len tshul gyi lam gyi ngo bo dang go rim dang grangs nges la phyin ci ma log pa'i nges pa 'khrungs nas gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa gang la'ang khol bton re tsam ma yin par thams cad gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du sbyar nas nyams len gyi phyogs su 'khyer shes pa/ de yang bshad pa tsam ma yin par da lta blo mtho dman dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gang yin gyis rgyud la bskor nas dmigs rnam gyi rim par nyams su len pa'i lag len du 'khyer bde zhing 'chun che la/ sems 'dul ba'i rim pa 'ba' zhig lhur mdzad pa'i sgo nas gdul bya mchog dman thams cad ji ltar bkri ba'i rim pa la mnga' brnyes/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i lus dang mthun pa 'ba' zhig mdzad cing / khyad par du rgyal ba dbang po'i tog gi spyan sngar snyigs ma'i dus su dbu sngags zung 'brel du spel ba'i thugs bskyed kyi go cha thun mong ma yin par bzhes pa dang mthun par tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa bya dka' la grangs mang zhing ngo mtshar ba mtha' dag sku nyams su bzhes te zhing 'dir sprul ba'i zlos gar mngon du mdzad pa'i dus su/ zab mo'i lam gyi gnad ma lus pa dang por 'tshol ba na'ang thugs stobs gzhan 'gran med pas bla ma red mda' ba la sogs pa'i mi'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs lha'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi bzhes pa'i sgo nas 'phags bod kyi dbu ma'i bstan bcos che ba rnams la phyogs re ba dang rags par ma song ba'i gsan sbyong mthar phyin pa mdzad de dgung lo zhe gcig gi dus su buddha pā li tar brten nas zab mo'i de kho na nyid kyi don ji bzhin rtogs pa'i ye shes klong du brdol ba'i tshul bstan cing / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyis dbu ma'i lugs bzang 'di nyid rmang nas nyams pa slar bsos te 'phags pa yab sras kyi gzhung gi sger 'grel du rtsa 'jug gi rnam bshad/ bod kyi lta ba'i 'dod tshul gyi 'khrul sel du lhag mthong chen mo/ rang lugs kyi lta ba'i snying po ma nor bar skyong ba'i don du lhag mthong chung ngu/ dbu sems kyi lta ba'i phra rags dang drang nges kyi don gsal bar byed pa'i ched du legs bshad snying po ste lta ba'i legs bshad chen po lnga mdzad pa la brten nas bstan pa'i snying po dri ma med pa 'di nyid da lta'i bar du 'jig rten na nyi zla bzhin du gas la bar mdzad do//skabs su babs pa drang nges rnam 'byed chen mo 'di nyid ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul ni/ skyid shod dga' ba gdong du rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la lta ba'i zab gnad mang du zhus pa'i tshe rje btsun gyis/thal rang gi khyad par/ lhan skyes dang kun btags kyis ji ltar bzung ba ltar gyi bdag rtags kyi dgag bya'i phra rags/ lta ba rnyed pa'i tshad/ thal 'gyur pa'i lta ba 'khrul med kyi don/ lugs de'i 20

kun rdzob 'jog tshul rnams gsungs pa la/ ji bzhin ma dgongs pa'i tshul gyis mi go bar 'dug la gas zhus pas/ 'di rnams ma brjed par gyis la zin ris su bris/ bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad du byas pa la gsol ba 'debs shing bsnyen sgrub byed pa dang / bsags sbyangs gnyis la legs par 'bad pa dang /gzhung lugs kyi don la rigs pas rnam par dpyod cing zhib tu sems pa rnams sum sgril du nyams su longs la tshim ma sla bar rgyun bsrings te legs par dpyod cig dang / skabs su bab na ngas da lta sa bon btab pa 'di rnams kyis kyang rkyen byas nas legs par go ba zhig myur du 'ong bar 'dug ces gsungs pa ltar gang gsungs rnams la zin bris kyi sa bon re mdzad cing / phyis dgung lo nga gcig pa'i dus se ra chos sdings su dbu ma'i rigs pa phra mo 'ga' zhig la dogs pa cung zad dpyad dka' ba byung nas bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la gsol 'debs drag tu mdzad pa na/ sher mdo'i stong nyid nyi shu'i 'gres rkang rnams gser btso ma'i yi ger bkod pa'i rnam pas bar snang khrig gis gang bar gzigs pa la brten nas dogs pa lhag med du chod de sngar gyi zin bris kyi sa bon la gzhi byas nas legs bshad snying po dang rtsa she'i rnam bshad chen mo mdzad pa yin no/ /se ra rje btsun pa'i mkhas grub rnam thar sogs su mkhan po g.yag yu'i slob ma g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal ba'am g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma zhes pa sa skya'i mkhas pa g.yag gzhon gnyis kyi nang tshan des rje thams cad mkhyen pa la drang nges las brtsams pa'i dri ba mang du zhus pa'i lan du drang nges rnam 'byed mdzad par bshad tshul yang yod do/ /gang ltar 'jam mgon bla mas bstan bcos 'di mdzad nas gzab bshad snga phyir gnang ba rgyal tshab mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs chos rje gsum ga las brgyud tshul byung zhing / dge ldan pa'i mkhas grub rim byon dag gis tshul 'di 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad do/ /de yang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi padmo'i ze'u 'bru gtsug gi rgyan du bzhes pa'i chos kyi sras po/ zab mo de kho na nyid kyi don ji bzhin gzigs nas rgya bod kyi legs bshad gung bsgrigs te 'chad pa la 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i rang 'dra gnyis pa/ rtsod dus paṇa chen kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang dpal ba la kho bo cag gis bka' drin du zhus skabs gsung gi bdud rtsi las rang blo dang 'tshams pa'i cha shas shig yang dag pa'i don la goms 'dris bgyid pa'i phyir 'god par 'dod do//21

rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa/skabs su bab pa'i bstan bcos kyi don dngos bshad pa/gnyis pa skabs su bab pa'i bstan bcos kyi don dngos bshad pa la gsum/ bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas te snod ldan nyan par bskul ba/brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi lus dngos bshad pa/ bstan bcos ji ltar brtsams pa'i tshul dge bsngo sbyar byang dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mchod par brjod pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba/ snod ldan nyan par bskul ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ drang nges kyi gnad gang la brten nas rnyed pa'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa/ bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la mchod par brjod pa/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu byams 'jam dbyangs dang shing rta chen po gnyis sogs la mchod par brjod pa'o//sa bcad dang po/bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas te snod ldan nyan par bskul ba/ngang po/ mchod par brjod pa/dang po drang nges kyi gnad gang las rnyed pa'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa/na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣa ya/ zhes byung / 'dud pa'i byings ṇa mra'i ṇa nar bsgyur te rkyen a sun byin/ u 41/ra tho radang na phyis nas mtshams sbyar ba la rnam dbye dang po'i si byin te i phyis shing sra rnam bcad byas pas na maḥgrub ste phyag 'tshal ba'am 'dud pa'o//nges par gnon pa'i byings shrī la rkyen ku byin te ka phyis nas/ shrī'i rī uru dang ka gar byas te drangs shing rnam dbye dang po'i si byin i phyis sa rnam bcad byas pas gu ru:grub ste bla ma'am gong ma'o//22

mtshar sdug gi byings mañdzu'i rjes 'brel phyis/ u rkyen dang nga si byin i dang a dang dra rnams phyis te drangs sa rnam bcad byas pas mañdzuḥsib ste 'jam pa'o//sgrogs pa'i byings lhuṣṭhadra la/ rkyen atsu byin/ ṭi dang rjes 'brel phyis te yon tan byas/ rnam dbye dang po'i si byin/ i phyis shing sa rnam bcad byas pas ghoṣartsigrub ste dbyangs sam skad do// de la na maḥ'i rnam bcad u dang de or byas/ rnam bcad gzhan rnams phyis te/ mthar rnam dbye bzhi pa'i gcig tshig nge byin/ de la akra a ga ma byin nas e a ya dang 'dra 'dus byas pas/ na mo gu ru mdzi gho ṣā ya/ zhes pa grub ste/ bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyas 'tshal lo zhes pa'o//de yang yon tan dang slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i sgo nas skye dgu'i gong mar gyur pa dang / rgyud lung rtogs kyi yon tan gyis lci ba dang / rkyen ngan pas rdzi mi nus shing slob mas bsten na rkyen dbang du mi 'gro ba'i bkan cha dang ldan pas na bla ma dang / 'jam zhes pas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i rtsub reg dang bral ba'i ngo bo nyid sku dang / dbyangs zhes pas gsung gi bdag rkyen ye shes chos sku dang ldan pas 'jam dbyangs sam/ sgrib gnyis kyi rtsub reg dang bral ba'i sku gnyis dang / gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu mnga' bas 'jam dbyangs sam/ snyan pa yid du 'ong ba'i gsung dbyangs dang ldan pas na 'jam dbyangs te/ sgron gsal las/ 'jam pa ni rnam par mi 'jig pa'o/ /dpal ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes kyang 'byung ngo / /de lta bu'i bla ma lhag pa'i lhar rje thams cad mkhyen pas sgo gsum gus pas btud de phyag mdzad pa'i dgos pa ni/ sde snod gsum gyi 'gyur phyag gi skabs mngon pa'i sde snod la brjod bya lhag pa shes rab kyi yul rang spyi'i mtshan nyid ji bzhin shes pa 'jam dbyangs la rag las pas de la 'gyur phyag byed pa dang mthun par/ bstan bcos 'di don dam pa'i mngon pa'i sde snod du go ba dang / mdzad pa pos dbu sems kyi lta ba dang drang nges kyi gnad gang las rnyed pa'i yul thun mong min pa yin pa dang / rjes 'jug lta ba 'tshol ba rnams kyis zab mo'i don khong du chud pa de la nges par ltos par ston pa'i phyir yin no//gnyis pa bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa bcom ldan 'das la mchod par brjod pa/ bde 'byung sprin la zhes sogs byung / mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs 'chang bas bde 'byung ste dbang phyug dang /sprin gyi phung bo dang mtshungs pa'i glang bo che la zhon pas sprin la zhon pa ste brgya byin dang / gser gyi kha dog can gyi sgo nga dang 'dra ba'i padma las skyes pas gser gyi mngal te tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug dka' thub la gnas pa bdud kyis mda' lngas nyams par byas pa la/ dbang phyug gi me'i mig la me sbar bas/lus bsregs te med par byas pas lus med de bdud kyang yin la bdud kyi bdag po yang yin pa'am/23

lus ni med kyang sems can gyi snying la gnas te srid pa'i kun sbyor sna tshogs rtsom pas 'dod chags la yid la nyal dang lus med ces bya zhing / — de gzhan la skyed pa'i bdag por gyur pa'am de la dbang bsgyur bas na lus med bdag po ste bdud sdig can dang / tha gu'am me tog lto ba la bcings pas na tha gu'i lto 'am me tog lto ste khyab 'jug dang / sogs kyis bsdus pa tshogs bdag dang / gdong drug dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / phur bu rnams srid pa gsum na blo gros dang mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran zla med par dregs pa ste khengs pa'i nga ro ches cher sgrogs pa'i rlom pa'am nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba rnams kyis thub dbang gang gi mdzes pa'i sku mthong ba'i mod la nyi mas srin bu me khyer zil gyis gnon pa bzhin du de thams cad zil gyis gnon par mdzad par gyur pa'i tshe lha de dag gi mdzes pa'i cod pan gyis thub dbang gang gi zhabs pad la gus pas sten par byed pa thub pa'i dbang po lha rnams kyi yang lhar gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ kyang zhes pa ni chen po rnams kyis 'dud na dman pa rnams kyis lta ci smos pa'o/ /des na dbang phyug ni zhi ba pa dang / tshangs pa ni tshangs pa ba dang / khyab 'jug ni khyab 'jug pa ste mu stegs kyi grub mtha' che ba gsum gyi ston pa dang / brgya byin ni sgra'i khungs gtug sa dang /bdud ni byed pa sna tshogs kyis skye bo rnams bstan pa la rgyab kyis phyogs par byed pa yin pas de dag tshig la thon par mdzad nas/ dregs pa'i lha gzhan 'jig rten na dregs pas rlom pa tsam yin pas tshig zin la thon par ma mdzad de/ de dag gis rgyal ba phyi nang gi chos smra ba thams cad kyis bkur ba'i zhing du ston pa yin zhing / tshul 'di lha las phul du byung ba'i yon tan brjod pa'i bstod pa yin pas lha las phul byung gi bstod pa'i brjod don thams cad 'dir sbyar nas bshad na mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad du 'gyur ro// dogs dpyod spro na/ yang snying du bde 'byung zhes pa dbang phyug las gzhan rgyud la bde ba 'byung tshul bshad pa ma gtogs/ dbang phyug rang la bde ba 'byung tshul bshad pa mi 'thad ces gsungs kyang /dbang phyug dgra sta'i rgyud las/ dbang phyug u ma mnyam sbyor pas/ /rmad du byung ba'i bde ba skyes/ /zhes dang / dbang phyug 'khrig pa spyad pa las/da /dbu ma'i ye shes skye bar 'dod/ /ces sogs dang bstun te/ gnyal ston gyis gsungs pa ltar lha mo u ma la brten nas dbang phyug la snyoms 'jug gi bde ba 'byung ba dang / mngon brjod 'grel ba 'dod 'jo'i ba mo dang / dka' 'grel ltar mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs 'chang ba dang / rab 'byor zla bas gsungs pa ltar dge ba'am thar ba dang bde ba'am dga' ba 'byung ba la bshad pa gang ltar byas kyang rung ste/ bde 'byung zhes pa rang las gzhan la bde ba 'byung tshul kho na las/ gzhan las rang la bde ba 'byung tshul la bshad na 'brel med du 'gyur don med 24

lus ni med kyang sems can gyi snying la gnas te srid pa'i kun sbyor sna tshogs rtsom pas 'dod chags la yid la nyal dang lus med ces bya zhing / — de gzhan la skyed pa'i bdag por gyur pa'am de la dbang bsgyur bas na lus med bdag po ste bdud sdig can dang / tha gu'am me tog lto ba la bcings pas na tha gu'i lto 'am me tog lto ste khyab 'jug dang / sogs kyis bsdus pa tshogs bdag dang / gdong drug dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / phur bu rnams srid pa gsum na blo gros dang mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran zla med par dregs pa ste khengs pa'i nga ro ches cher sgrogs pa'i rlom pa'am nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba rnams kyis thub dbang gang gi mdzes pa'i sku mthong ba'i mod la nyi mas srin bu me khyer zil gyis gnon pa bzhin du de thams cad zil gyis gnon par mdzad par gyur pa'i tshe lha de dag gi mdzes pa'i cod pan gyis thub dbang gang gi zhabs pad la gus pas sten par byed pa thub pa'i dbang po lha rnams kyi yang lhar gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ste/ kyang zhes pa ni chen po rnams kyis 'dud na dman pa rnams kyis lta ci smos pa'o/ /des na dbang phyug ni zhi ba pa dang / tshangs pa ni tshangs pa ba dang / khyab 'jug ni khyab 'jug pa ste mu stegs kyi grub mtha' che ba gsum gyi ston pa dang / brgya byin ni sgra'i khungs gtug sa dang /bdud ni byed pa sna tshogs kyis skye bo rnams bstan pa la rgyab kyis phyogs par byed pa yin pas de dag tshig la thon par mdzad nas/ dregs pa'i lha gzhan 'jig rten na dregs pas rlom pa tsam yin pas tshig zin la thon par ma mdzad de/ de dag gis rgyal ba phyi nang gi chos smra ba thams cad kyis bkur ba'i zhing du ston pa yin zhing / tshul 'di lha las phul du byung ba'i yon tan brjod pa'i bstod pa yin pas lha las phul byung gi bstod pa'i brjod don thams cad 'dir sbyar nas bshad na mkhas pa dgyes pa'i legs bshad du 'gyur ro// dogs dpyod spro na/ yang snying du bde 'byung zhes pa dbang phyug las gzhan rgyud la bde ba 'byung tshul bshad pa ma gtogs/ dbang phyug rang la bde ba 'byung tshul bshad pa mi 'thad ces gsungs kyang /dbang phyug dgra sta'i rgyud las/ dbang phyug u ma mnyam sbyor pas/ /rmad du byung ba'i bde ba skyes/ /zhes dang / dbang phyug 'khrig pa spyad pa las/da /dbu ma'i ye shes skye bar 'dod/ /ces sogs dang bstun te/ gnyal ston gyis gsungs pa ltar lha mo u ma la brten nas dbang phyug la snyoms 'jug gi bde ba 'byung ba dang / mngon brjod 'grel ba 'dod 'jo'i ba mo dang / dka' 'grel ltar mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs 'chang ba dang / rab 'byor zla bas gsungs pa ltar dge ba'am thar ba dang bde ba'am dga' ba 'byung ba la bshad pa gang ltar byas kyang rung ste/ bde 'byung zhes pa rang las gzhan la bde ba 'byung tshul kho na las/ gzhan las rang la bde ba 'byung tshul la bshad na 'brel med du 'gyur don med 24

pa'i phyir zer na brtag la/ sdug bden la kun 'byung gi sgra bshad pa 'brel med du mi 'gyur tshul drang nges dogs dpyod legs bshad kun btus su 'byung bas der blta'o/ /rab 'byor zla ba'i bshad tshul 'di dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad kyi tha ma dga' mgur gnas pa'i don yang yin par yang snying du gsungs pa la/ dpyod ldan yid kyi mun sel du/ dbang phyug la brten nas gzhan gyis thar pa'am gnas skabs kyi bde ba thob pa dbang phyug rang nyid dga' mgur gnas pa'i don du gzhag dka' ba 'dra/ zhes dpyad gzhir mdzad do/ /de la spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs kyis/ thar ba'am yang na lha yi lus/ /gang du bdag nyid 'dod pa dag /thams cad 'dod pa thob 'gyur pas/ /des na dga' mgur gnas zhes bya/ /zhes dbang phyug gi gzhung drangs nas gsungs pa dang mthun par/ rim lnga gsal sgron dang le'u bco lnga ba'i sgron gsal mchan gnyis kur/ gang thob par 'dod pa'i don de ltar thob nus pa ni dga' mgur gnas pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i don grub mchan las/ rang nyid zhi ba thob cing gzhan la mtho ris dang thar ba gang 'dod ster ba ni de'i dga' mgur gnas pa'i yon tan yin te/ zhes 'byung ba don gnas yin tshe snga ma ltar ro/ /yon tan gyi dbang phyug brgyad ni mchog gi dngos grub yin pas 'bras bu'i skabs kho nar yod par rim lnga gsal sgron dang sgron gsal mchan du gsungs pa ltar la/ dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad ni/ spyod bsdus chag 'gyur las/ gzugs phra ba dang reg pa yang / /khyab pa yang dag thob pa nyid/ /rab tu gsal ba nyid brtan pa/ /dbang phyug nyid dang 'dod dgur 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs brtul zhugs las/ phra ba dang / yang ba dang / mchod par bya ba dang / bdag por gyur pa dang / dbang du gyur pa dang / gar yang phyin pa dang / 'dod dgur ldan pa dang / dga' mgur gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ so so'i ngo bo rgyas par rim lnga gsal sgron dang sgron gsal le'u bco lnga ba'i mchan dang grub mtha' chen mo mchan dang bcas pa las shes par bya'o/ /brgya byin gyi gzhon pa'i glang bo sprin dang 'dra mtshungs sbyor tshul la gnyal ston dang sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs kyis sprin gyi shugs 'chang ba'i glang bo zhes mgyogs khyad la sbyar ba dang / 'dod 'jo'i ba mo las sprin chen po glang bo che'i gzugs 'dzin par bshad pa'i don/ yang snying du shin tu che zhing dal gyis g.yo bas brjid pa'i nyams dang sbyar ba glang bo'i skyes rabs las/ ston ku'i sprin nam bun gyi tshogs rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin du tshur 'ongs pa mthong ngo / /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par bshad pa dang / kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang pos glang bo thal mdog yin pas sprin dang 'dra bar gsungs kyang che ba dang brjid pa'i dper sprin blangs pa 'dod 'jo'i ba mo dang glang bo'i skyes rabs gnyis kur mi gsal lo/ /ye shes snying po kun btus kyi 'grel bar tshangs pa me dkyil gyi dbus su gser gyi sgo nga smin pa las byung bar bshad pa dang /25

dran pa'i gzhung las sgo nga de chu las byung bar bshad pa ni/ yang snying las/ gnyi ga rig byed la grags pa'i gtam rgyud bkod pa tsam yin gyi don dngos gnas ma yin pa'i phyir/ zhes ga/ sungs pa ltar ro/ /gzhan yang rig byed las tshangs pa dbang phyug gi sa bon las sprul pa dang / khyab 'jug gi lto ba'i padma las skyes pa dang / des 'jig rten thams cad byas pa dang / de sgong skyes/ khyab 'jug mngal skyes/dbang phyug bdag skyes su bshad pa sogs dngos gnas su khas blang mi rung zhing / za ma tog bkod par tshangs pa spyan ras gzigs kyi phrag pa g.yas nas byung bar gsungs so/ /tshangs pa rdzus skyes yin gyi sgo nga mtshan nyid pa las skyes pa ma yin pas sngar ltar bshad dgos shing / spyir sgong skyes ni mngal las skyes pa yin yang mngal skyes ma yin te/ mngal du lus kyi mtshan nyid rnams rdzogs nas skyes pa mngal skyes dang /der de ma rdzogs par sgo nga las rdzogs pa la sgong skyes su bshad pa'i phyir/ lus med kyi bdag po byas na'ang drug sgra de gzhi mthun sdud pa'i 'brel sgrar byas chog pas/ lus med bdag po zhes pa dang / lus med kyi bdag po zhes pa gnyis kyi tshig nus la khyad med par snang ngo / /des na khas len gyi rgyun la/lus med bdag po byas na lus med dang bdag po don gcig tu 'gro yang / lus med kyi bdag po byas na lus med 'dod chags dang bdag po dga' rab dbang phyug la go dgos/ zhes zer rgyun 'dug mod/yang snying du lus med dang lus med kyi bdag po so sor 'jog na'ang dga' rab dbang phyug la lus med bdag po dang lus med ces pa'i tha snyad gnyis ka sbyar chog par bzhed par mngon no/ /mchan du 'dod pa ba rnams khams gong ma la ltos te lus chud bas lus med pa dang 'dra zhing / bdud de'i bdag po yin pas lus med bdag por gsungs kyang / yang snying du de bkag go/ bdud kyi mda' lnga ni sgron gsal las/ dregs pa dang / rmongs pa dang / kun tu rmongs pa dang / brgyal ba dang / sems med par byed pa lnga dang / gzhan yang rgyal ba'i lha sogs kyis bshad pa rnams ming mi 'dra ba ma gtogs don phal cher 'dra bar snang zhing mda' lnga so so'i don le'u bcu drug pa'i sgron gsal mchan las byung ba ltar la/ bdud ni dbang phyug gi mig gsum ga las me byung bas bsregs pa dang / mig dbus ma'i mes bsregs par bshad pa gnyis snang yang phyi ma'i phyogs ltar mdzad pa mang ngo / /dran pa'i gzhung las / tha gu'i lto ni byis pa'i tshe/ /tha gu'i ske rags bcings pa'o/ /zhes pa dang mthun par tshig gter 'grel bar yang bshad pa dang /'dod 'jo 'gyur gsar du grags pa dang snying rje dang rol ba dang sel ba'i don gyis me tog gi chun po rnams 'di'i lto ba la ldan pas na me tog lto bar bshad pa dang / 'dod 'jo shong 'gyur du khyab 'jug gi chung ma lha mo grags mas khyab 'jug gi mgo la me tog 'jog par 'dod pa la ma slebs par lto ba la bzhag pas me tog lto bar bshad pa'i lugs gsum snang zhing / yang snying las/ dā mo da raḥni/ snga ma rnams 26

tha gu'i lto bar bsgyur ba ltar byas pa yin la/ zhes khyab 'jug la tha gu'i lto bar byas pa ni 'gyur ma legs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa lta bu zhig gsungs so/ /rig byed las/ nya dang rus sbal phag pa dang / /mi yi seng ge mi'u thung dang / /rā ma gnyis dang nag pa dang / /sangs rgyas kirti rtse dang bcu/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar gyi khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu grub mtha' chen mo sogs las rtogs par bya'o/ /sogs khong nas 'don rgyu dka' 'grel du nyi zla tshogs bdag gdong drug bzhi dang / yang snying du de'i steng phur bu bcas lnga dang / byang rtse sbyin pa dar rgyas kyis tshig la thon pa dang lnga dang ma thon pa bzhi las nyi zla gcig tu bgrangs nas brgyad du byed par bshad pa dang / rje 'jigs med dbang pos 'ga' zhig gis lha 'di dag la dregs pa'i lha brgyad zer yang dgu yod par gsungs pa sogs 'dra min mang yang / yongs grags kyi dregs pa'i lha brgyad ni tshig tu thon pa lnga las bdud dor nas sogs sgras bsdus pa bzhi pacas brgyad la byed do/ /gnod sbyin shākya 'phel gyis phyag byas pas dang / blo gros yangs pa khyod la 'di dang ni/ /kun spyan zhabs la lan gsum phyag bgyis te/ /bltams pa'i tshe na sa ni g.yos pa dang / /'dzam bu'i grib ma sku las ma 'das pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar yab kyis lan gsum du phyag phul bas lha'i lhar mtshan gsol tshul sogs yod kyang skabs 'dir dregs pa'i lha rnams kyi'ang lhar gyur pas na lha'i lha zhes bshad na skabs don dang 'grig par mngon no/ /'dir ston par lha chen rnams kyis btud tshul gyi sgo nas bstod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni yang snying du/ 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pas rgya che ba'i yon tan sgos bstod pa bzhin du/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ zhes dang / skabs gsum pa dang dbang po'i dgra/ /zhes sogs kyis sgrub phyogs nas 'gro rnams srid zhi'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i skyabs su gyur tshul sgos bstod pa dang mi 'dra bar/ smra ba zla med 'dren mchog shākya'i tog /ces pas zab mo'i yon tan sgos bstod pa bzhin du/ lha chen de dag gis lam ltar snang bstan pa rnams rgyal ba'i gsung bi 'od zer gyis rmeg med du bcom ste smra ba zla med du gyur pa'i sgos bstod pa yin gsungs pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i legs bshad yin pa gzhir byas kyang / lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ zhes pas ston pa phun tshogs dang / skabs gsum pa dang zhes sogs kyis 'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan du gyur tshul gyi yon tan bstan pa tsam las zab rgyas kyi yon tan gang la sbyar mi gsal zhing / sbyor na ston pa zhes pa'i tshig nus kyis lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ zhes pa ni zab mo'i yon tan la sbyar na 'grigs pa dang / 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pas kyang rgya che ba'i yon tan gyi sgo nas bstod pa'ang mi gsal ba dang / 'dir/ rlom pas 'gying rnams kyis kyang gang gi gsung / /thos pa'i mod la nyi mas mye khyer bzhin/ /zhes yod tshe smra ba zla med dang sbyor rung tsam snang med de ltar ma gsungs pas shes byed dka' zhing / skabs gsum pa dang zhes 27

sogs kyis smra ba zla med dang / 'dis rgya che ba'i yon tan brjod de bstod ces bzlog ste khas blangs na'ang gnod byed dka' bar dogs so/ /brjod bya lus dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod mādzad pa la dgongs na'ang brtag dgos te/ bstan bcos yin tshad kyi mchod brjod brjod bya'i lus dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod du sgrub dka' zhing / dka' 'grel sogs su 'di la bstan bcos lus kyi mchod brjod ces pa las bstan bcose lus dang mthun pa'i mchod brjod ces gsungs pa mi snang ba'i phyir ro//gsum pa byams 'jam dbyangs dang shing rta chen po gnyis sogs la mchod par brjod pa la gsum/bstan 'dzin mtha' dag gi mes po byams 'jam dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa/ shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi slob dpon klu sgrub dang thogs med la mchod par brjod pa/ shing rta'i srol 'dzin gyi bshes gnyen 'phags pa lha dang dbyig gnyen sogs la mchod par brjod pa'o//gcig byams 'jam dbyangs la mchod par brjod pa/ mkhyen brtse'i gting mtha' zhes sogs byung / rgya mtsho la gting mtha' dpag dka' ba dang / rlabs phreng chal chil g.yo ba dang / rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i khyad chos gsum yod pa bzhin du byams 'jam dbyangs gnyis zab don 'byed pa'i mkhyen rab zab pas gting dang / gzhan phan gyi brtse ba rgya che bas mtha' dpag par dka' ba dang ldan pa khyad chos dang po dang / byang chub kyi spyod pa ste phyin drug spyi dang / khyad par mdzad pa bcu gnyis sogs rgyal ba'i mdzad pa thams cad khur du 'khyer ba'i rlabs chen chal chil g.yo ba khyad chos gnyis pa dang / zab rgyas kyi legs bshad rin po che'i gter du gyur pa khyad chos gsum pa ste khyad par de gsum dang ldan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rgyal tshab byams mgon gnyis la gus pas phyag 'tshal ba ste/yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis 'di dang mchod brjod gong ma gnyis bsdoms pas theg chen gyi lam 'bras cha tshang bstan par gsungs so//spro na/ kha cig dpe rgya mtsho'i chos gsum dang sbyor rgyu'i don ni/ 'jam dbyangs la mkhyen pa dang / zab mo gtso bor gyur pa'i spyod pa dang / de gtso bor gyur pa'i legs bshad gsum dang /byams pa la de'i zlas drangs pa'i brtse ba sogs gsum la bshad pa dang / kha cig sngar ltar gnyis ka la gnyis ka sbyor bar bshad pa gang byas kyang 'dra la/ gting mtha' dpag dka' ba gnyis ka mkhyen brtse gnyis kur sbyar nas/ brtse ba'i gting dpag dka' ba ni de 'dzad pa med pa dang / de'i mtha' dpag dka' ba mi brtse yul gyi sems can mtha' med pa la shing bza' parnyi tas gsungs so/ /rje btsun byams pa la sangs rgyas byang sems gnyis yod pas spyir de sangs 'phags yin mi zer yang 'dir mchod par brjod yul gyi rgyal tshab byams pa skye ba gcig thogs pa'i byang sems rnam can du khas len dgos shing / 28

dga' ldan rten can gyi byams pa sangs rgyas stong gi lnga par 'dod pa dang / rgyan rtsom pa po byang sems su 'dod pa mi 'thad par phar phyin mtha' dpyod du gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir snang tshod kyi dbang du byas nas byang sems lugs su mchod brjod mdzad cing / thun mong min pa ltar na rgyal tshab byams pa sangs rgyas dang de'i mdzad pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dngos gnas pa dang byang sems kyi mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa dang / thun mong ba ltar na byang sems sa bcu ba pa yin par 'dod dgos so/ /'di'i thun mong ba mngon rtogs rgyan dang de min pa rgyud bla'i lugs su byed pa dang / thun mong ba drang don dang de min pa nges don du byed pa dang / blo thun mong ba par phyin theg pa dang de min pa sngags kyi theg pa la byed pa yod kyang / snang tshod ltar min pa'i gnas tshod cig khas len pa'i ngor bzhag pa thun mong min pa dang /snang tshod dang gnas tshod mthun par khas len pa'i ngor bzhag pa thun mong ba la byed pa legs sam snyam mo//rgyan rtsom pa po'i byams pa dang / bskal bzang rnam 'dren lnga pa'i mdzad pa ston dgos kyi de dang /dga' ldan rten can gyi de dang / sangs rgyas stong gi nang tshan gyi de rnams sangs 'phags dang / dge slong rnam dag dang / mchog gi sprul skur kun mkhyen bla mas gsungs pa ni dngos po'i gnas tshod kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin zhing / rje 'jigs med dbang pos/ rgyan rtsom pa po dga' ldan gnas su bzhugs tshe rang las gzhan sangs 'phags kyi rnam can du med pas rang mchog sprul rnam can dang / gling 'dir ston pa'i 'khor du byon tshe rang las gzhan mchog sprul rnam can gyi 'khor gyi rnam pa 'dzin dgos stabs/ dga' ldan gnas la ltos te sangs 'phags dang / gling 'di la ltos te byang 'phags rnam can du khas len par gsungs te/ mchog sprul rnam can zhig mchog sprul rnam can gzhan zhig gi 'khor du byung ba na byang 'phags rnam can du 'gyur pa ngo mtshar che'o zhes gzhan dag zer ro//gnyis/ shing rta'i srol 'byed klu sgrub dang thogs med la mchod par brjod pa/ bder gshegs gsung rab ces sogs byung / sher mdo gtso bor gyur pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab spyi la/rnam bshad rigs pa las/ tshul gyi sgra ni bden pa dang / /lam dang 'brel 'byung rig pa dang / /zhes dang / smra sgo las/ tshul ni 'dra dang smad pa dang / /sgo dang sdom pa mtshan nyid dang / /thabs dang rig pa don dang 'dod/ /legs pa dag la 'jug pa las/ /zhes pa ltar tshul don du mar 'jug pa las/'dir drang nges su 'jog pa'i lam srol mi 'dra ba'i shing rta'i srol chen po gnyis phye ba ste/ klu sgrub kyis chos thams cad tha snyad du yod cing don dam par med pa'i srol dang / thogs med kyis gzhan dbang yongs grub bden par grub pa dang kun btags kyi chos rnams bden par med pa'i srol phye ba'o/ /de lta bu'i srol gnyis legs par phye ba la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du theg chen gyi 29

dga' ldan rten can gyi byams pa sangs rgyas stong gi lnga par 'dod pa dang / rgyan rtsom pa po byang sems su 'dod pa mi 'thad par phar phyin mtha' dpyod du gsungs pa ltar ro/ /'dir snang tshod kyi dbang du byas nas byang sems lugs su mchod brjod mdzad cing / thun mong min pa ltar na rgyal tshab byams pa sangs rgyas dang de'i mdzad pa sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dngos gnas pa dang byang sems kyi mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa dang / thun mong ba ltar na byang sems sa bcu ba pa yin par 'dod dgos so/ /'di'i thun mong ba mngon rtogs rgyan dang de min pa rgyud bla'i lugs su byed pa dang / thun mong ba drang don dang de min pa nges don du byed pa dang / blo thun mong ba par phyin theg pa dang de min pa sngags kyi theg pa la byed pa yod kyang / snang tshod ltar min pa'i gnas tshod cig khas len pa'i ngor bzhag pa thun mong min pa dang /snang tshod dang gnas tshod mthun par khas len pa'i ngor bzhag pa thun mong ba la byed pa legs sam snyam mo//rgyan rtsom pa po'i byams pa dang / bskal bzang rnam 'dren lnga pa'i mdzad pa ston dgos kyi de dang /dga' ldan rten can gyi de dang / sangs rgyas stong gi nang tshan gyi de rnams sangs 'phags dang / dge slong rnam dag dang / mchog gi sprul skur kun mkhyen bla mas gsungs pa ni dngos po'i gnas tshod kyi dbang du mdzad pa yin zhing / rje 'jigs med dbang pos/ rgyan rtsom pa po dga' ldan gnas su bzhugs tshe rang las gzhan sangs 'phags kyi rnam can du med pas rang mchog sprul rnam can dang / gling 'dir ston pa'i 'khor du byon tshe rang las gzhan mchog sprul rnam can gyi 'khor gyi rnam pa 'dzin dgos stabs/ dga' ldan gnas la ltos te sangs 'phags dang / gling 'di la ltos te byang 'phags rnam can du khas len par gsungs te/ mchog sprul rnam can zhig mchog sprul rnam can gzhan zhig gi 'khor du byung ba na byang 'phags rnam can du 'gyur pa ngo mtshar che'o zhes gzhan dag zer ro//gnyis/ shing rta'i srol 'byed klu sgrub dang thogs med la mchod par brjod pa/ bder gshegs gsung rab ces sogs byung / sher mdo gtso bor gyur pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab spyi la/rnam bshad rigs pa las/ tshul gyi sgra ni bden pa dang / /lam dang 'brel 'byung rig pa dang / /zhes dang / smra sgo las/ tshul ni 'dra dang smad pa dang / /sgo dang sdom pa mtshan nyid dang / /thabs dang rig pa don dang 'dod/ /legs pa dag la 'jug pa las/ /zhes pa ltar tshul don du mar 'jug pa las/'dir drang nges su 'jog pa'i lam srol mi 'dra ba'i shing rta'i srol chen po gnyis phye ba ste/ klu sgrub kyis chos thams cad tha snyad du yod cing don dam par med pa'i srol dang / thogs med kyis gzhan dbang yongs grub bden par grub pa dang kun btags kyi chos rnams bden par med pa'i srol phye ba'o/ /de lta bu'i srol gnyis legs par phye ba la brten nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang / khyad par du theg chen gyi 29

bstan pa gsal bar mdzad pas bstan pa mchog ces gsungs pa yin te/ yang snying las/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog ces pa'ang mchog gi sgra nye tshig tu byas te bstan pa spyi la sbyar kyang rung la/ 'on kyang zhi ba tu brtags na dpal mgon klu sgrub ni zab mo'i lam gyi bka' bab dang / 'phags pa thogs med rgya che ba'i lam gyi bka' bab yin pas/ gnyi ga bsdoms te zab rgyas zung du 'jug pa'i theg pa mchog gi lam bzang gsal bar mdzad pa'i don du byas na legs pas/ bstan pa mchog ces pa'ang thabs shes ya bral du ma song ba'i theg chen gyi bstan pa la bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /theg chen gyi bstan pa de yang sa gsum gyi 'gro ba rnams kyi nang na nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad pa po ni klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis yin pas de gnyis ma'i zhabs la spyi bos 'dud par mdzad do//skabs 'dir mkho ba'i spyi'i don ni/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa ltar mi'i sha tshugs can gyi 'grel byed gzhan la ma brten par nges don gyi gsung rab kyi don gzhan du 'grel ba la gnod byed dang gzhan du drang du mi rung bar don der nges pa'i sgrub byed bstan pa'i sgo nas gsung rab la shing rta'i lam srol lta bu'i drang nges kyi don legs par phye ba'i gang zag de/ shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ gzhung las/ gsung rab kyi drang nges 'byed par lung bstan pa'i shing rta chen po dag gis drang nges kyi dgongs pa bkral cing / de yang nges don gyi gsung rab kyi don gzhan du 'dren pa la gnod byed dang / gzhan du drang du mi rung bar don der nges pa'i sgrub byed kyi rigs pas legs par gtan la phab/ ces dang /gser phreng las/ de ltar grags kyang brgyad stong don bsdus kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo stong nyid bcu drugarnam g.yeng gi rtog pa bcu'i gnyen por sgrub pa la gdams pa'i mdo'i 'grel tshul dang / nas/ dbus mtha' dang theg pa chen po bsdus pa ji lta ba bzhin du snang bas/ byams chos las logs su srol btod pa min zhing / gzhung 'grel ni stong nyid bcu drug dang skye 'gag kun byang med pa'i skabs su rtsa she'i lung drangs nas klu sgrub zhabs kyi rigs pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'chad 'dod par 'dug pas/ klu sgrub kyi rigs tshogs las bshad srol zur du byed pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /lung snga ma 'di'i shes byed du sbyar ba'i don dogs dpyod du 'chad la/ phyi ma ni de la mi'i sha tshugs can gyi 'grel byed gzhan la ma brten par phye ba zhig dgos pa'i shes byed du drangs so/ /shing rta chen po gnyis rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i tshul ni/ lang gshegs las/ lho phyogs bai da'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dpal ldan cher grags pa/ /de ming klu zhes 'bod pa ste/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig pa/ /nga yi theg pa 'jig rten du/ /bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa bsgrubs te/ /bde ba can du de 'gro 'o/ /zhes mtha' gnyis 'jig pa'i dbu ma'i drang nges 'byed par gsungs pa dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/30

de bzhin gshegs pa nga 'das nas/ /lo ni bzhi pargya lon pa na/ /dge slong klu zhes de 'bod 'byung / /bstan pa la ni dad cing phan/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob pa/ /lo ni drug brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /rig pa rma bya chen mo ni/ /bdag nyid chen po des kyang 'grub/ /bstan bcos sna tshogs don dang ni/ /dngos po med pa'i don de rig /ces sna tshogs pa'i don te drang don dang / dngos po med pa'i don te nges don gsal bar byed par gsungs pas klu sgrub dang / de nyid las/ thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /bstan bcos de ni don la mkhas/ /mdo sde nges don drang ba'i don/ /rnam pa mang po rab tu 'byed/ /ces rnam rig pa dang mthun pa'i drang nges gsal bar 'byed par gsungs pas thogs med lung bstan pa yin no/ /dbye na/ dbu ma ba dang / rnam rig pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis te/ dang po dang rigs tshogs mdzad pa po'i klu sgrub don gcig gnyis pa dang sa sde mdzad pa po'i thogs med don gcig go /de ltar du gzhung las/ rgyu rkyen la rag las pa nyid kyis rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa med pa yin pa la rang gi mtshan nyid kyis ma grub na bcings grol dang blang dor dang rgyu 'bras sogs med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smra ba ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa'i rang bzhin gyis stong ba'i sgrub byed mthar thug pa la gnod byed mthar thug par 'dzin pa yin no zhes 'chad pa 'di ni mgon po klu sgrub kyis yum gyi mdo dang de dang rjes su mthun pa'i gsung rab rnams kyi don gzhan du drang du mi rung bar don der nges pa'i nges don du sgrub pa'i sgrub byed kyi rigs pa dang / de dag dang mi mthun par ston pa'i mdo rnams kyi sgra ji bzhin pa la rigs pa'i gnod pa ston pa'i shing rta'i srol phye ba yin no/ /zhes dang / stong thun las/ de bas na 'phags pa'i gzhung 'di dag gis dgag sgrub la sogs pa'i bya byed thams cad kun rdzob ming du btags pa tsam la 'jog gi rang gi mtshan nyid kyis grub pa la bzhag tu mi rung ba dang / chos gang la yang rang bzhin cung zad kyang med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis rgyas par gtan la phab cing /tshul de ltar rtogs pa ni sangs rgyas thob pa lta ci smos/ 'khor ba las grol ba la yang med du mi rung ngo zhes lung dang rigs pa mtha' yas pa'i sgo nas bstan pas/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin du gsal bar mdzad pa'i shing rta'i srol legs par phye ba yin no/ /zhes klu sgrub dbu ma ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du gsungs shing / gzhung las/ bdag nyid chen po thogs med kyis rnam par rig pa tsam gyi tshul gyi shing rta chen po'i srol phye/ zhes thogs med rnam rig pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du gsungs so/ /de ltar shing rta'i srol 'byed pa gnyis su grangs nges pa yin te/ gzhung las/ bder sashegs gsung rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /nas/ klu sgrub thogs med ces dang / shing rta chen po'i srol gnyis legs bzung nas/ /zhes dang / gsung 31

rab kyi drang nges phye nas de kho na nyid gtan la 'bebs pa'i shing rta'i srol gnyis/ zhes dang / smra ba'i khyu mchog klu sgrub thogs med kyis/ /ji bzhin bkral ba'i tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /zhes dang /mgon po klu sgrub kyis ngo bo nyid med pa'i tshul dang / bdag nyid chen po thogs med kyis rnam par rig pa tsam gyi tshul gyi shing rta chen po'i srol gnyis phye/ zhes dang / lam rim chen mor/ shing rta chen po gnyis las legs brgyud pa'i/ /zhes dang / lam rim che chung gnyis ma'i thog mtha' gnyis kur/ shing rta chen po klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis ma'i lam srol/ zhes sogs rje'i legs bshad mang po dang /stong thun las/ gsung rab kyi drang nges 'byed pa'i tshul la theg pa chen po'i shing rta'i srol ni gnyis te/zhes dang / rgyud bla dar ṭīka dang / phar phyin rnam bshad sogs sras kyi thu bo rnams kyi gsung las kyang shing rta chen po gnyis su gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /me'i 'grel byed gzhan la ma brten par rgya che ba'i rnam gzhag shing rta'i lam srol lta bu'i srol chen po phye ba'i gang zag de/ rgya che ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi mtshan nyid/ de dang rgyan rtsom pa po don gcig des zab mo'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi mtshan nyid dang rnam grangs kyang shes nus so/ /de skad du gser phreng las/ dngos bstan stong nyid kyi don rigs tshogs dang / shugs bstan stong nyid bshad pa na gdul bya'i rgyud la mngon rtos/sa skye ba'i rim pa rnams rgyan gyis bkral bas/ rje btsun dang klu sgrub zhabs gnyis kyi sher phyin 'grel tshul gnyis su byung ngo / /zhes bya bar yang gnas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rnam rigs tsam gyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum kyi shing rta'i lam srol lta bu'i srol chen po gsar du phye ba'i cha nas bzhag pa'i gang zag de/ rnam rig pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi mtshan nyid/ des thal 'gyur pa dang rang rgyud pa spyi bye brag gi shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi mtshan nyid kyang rigs bsgre'o/ /thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la zla ba grags pa 'jog dgos te/gzhung las/ rang sde'i gzhung 'gyur pa rnams las thal rang gang 'dod brtags nas rang rgyud mi 'thad thal 'gyur 'thad ces pa ni zla ba'i gzhung rjes 'brang dang bcas pa min pa nas dngos su ma byung ngo / /zhes dang / byung tshul ni/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad kyi don bkral ba la legs ldan gyis skyon bzung ba mi 'jug par ston pa'i skabs su tshig gsal las sangs rgyas bskyangs rang rgyud mi bzhed pa dang dbu ma bas rang rgyud bya mi rigs pa'i sgrub byed dang ldog phyogs la gnod byed mang du bstan nas shing rta'i srol phye la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /legs ldan gyis rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol phye ba ni/ stong thun las/ slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis rtsa she'i 'grel ba mdzad nas/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur du bkral ba la dgag pa mang du mdzad de/ rang rgyud kyi srol thog mar phye ba yin la/ zhes gsungs te/ thal bzlog gi dgag gzhag 32

byed lugs kyis kyang shes nus so/ /slob dpon 'di mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyang yin te/ gzhung las/ dgongs 'grel las mtshan nyid gsum gsungs pa'i don rnal 'byor spyod pa ba dag gis ji ltar bkral ba mdo'i don min par dbu ma'i don du 'grel ba'i lam srol 'di ni legs ldan 'byed kyis phye ba zhib tu ni dbu ma snang ba las bshad/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i dbu ma rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed zhi ba 'tsho yin pa ni/ gzhung las/ gzhung rgyas par brtsams nas tha snyad du phyi rol med pa'i tshul gyi dbu ma'i grub mtha' ni slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos srol phye bar slob dpon ye shes sdes bzhed pa ltar legs so/ /zhes dang / stong thun las/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos tha snyad du phyi don med cing rang rig yod pa dang shes pa bden par ma grub pa'i dbu ma'i lugs kyi srol thog mar phye nas dbu ma rgyan mdzad/ ces gsungs pa ltar ro//spro na/ dgongs 'grel dang / blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa gnyis drang nges 'byed byed dang /sher mdo gtso bor gyur pa'i gsung rab thams cad drang nges 'byed gzhir 'jog dgos pas/ kha cigabader gshegs gsung rab tshul gnyis shing rta'i srol/ /zhes pa'i gsung rab la de gnyis tsam 'jog pa mi 'thad pa dang / yang snying las/ dgongs 'grel dang / blo gros mi zad pas bshad tshul ltar gyi shing rta'i srol gnyis phye bar bstan zer ba mi 'thad/ ces pa'i sgras zin la mun sel du/ klu sgrub thogs med gnyis kyis dbu sems kyi shing rta'i srol phye ba de blo gros mi zad pa dang dgongs 'grel las bshad tshul ltar phye ba min par thal ba bkod pa dang / bod snga mas shing rta'i srol 'byed bzhir byed pa gser phreng du bkag pa ltar dang / gsung rab kyi dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel ba'i gang zag shing rta'i srol 'byed du 'jog na rab 'byor dang thogs med kyis ma nges par phar phyin mtha' dpyod du gsungs so/ /sngar shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi 'jog byed du drangs pa'i gzhung gi lung shing rta'i srol 'byed spyi la sbyor dgos pa tshig zin la mi gsal yang / lcang skya'i grub mthar sbyar ba don la gnas te/ spyir shing rta'i srol phye ba'i don theg chen gyi grub mtha'i dbang du byas pa dang / de yang dbu sems kyi drang nges kyi shing rta'i srol phye ba la bya dgos pa 'chad par 'gyur zhing / gzhung du'ang shing rta chen po dang drang nges phye ba'i shing rta chen po la khyad ma phye bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /kho na re/ klu sgrub thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin par thal/ des chos thams cad rang mtshan gyis ma grub pa dang / ming rkyang btags yod tsam la bya byed 'thad pa'i tshul gyi shing rta'i srol phye ba sngar drangs pa'i lung gnyis su gsal ba gang / tshul de thal 'gyur pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lam srol chen po yin la/ de phye ba las lhag pa'i thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed tshul med pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ de ni dbu ma'i spyi bshad skabs yin pas/ don dam par 33

med pa dang rang bzhin gyis med pa la khyad ma phye bar chos thams cad bden par med pa'i srol phye ba'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gser phreng las/ rje btsun dang klu sgrub zhabs gnyis kyis sher phyin 'grel tshul gnyis byung bar gsungs pa la brten nas rje btsun byams pa shing rta'i srol 'byed du bzhed pa dang / de rgya che ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin yang shing rta'i srol 'byed ma yin par 'dod pa'i lugs gnyis las phyi mas/gser phreng las gsungs pa rje btsun byams pa rgya che ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin pa'i shes byed du rung gi spyir shing rta'i srol 'byed yin pa'i shes byed du mi rung ste/ rgya che ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin na shing rta'i srol 'byed yin mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin na shing rta'i srol 'byed yin mi dgos pa'i phyir zer ba la/ snga mas ma khyab ste/ spyir shing rta'i srol 'byed yin min mi'i sha tshugs can gyi 'grel byed gzhan la ma brten par rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel mi 'grel gyi steng nas 'jog pa gang / rje btsun byams pas de ltar 'grel gyi zla ba grags pas de ltar mi 'grel ba'i phyir zer/ gzhan yang snga mas spyir shing rta'i srol 'byed la gsum yod kyang drang nges 'byed pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la gnyis su grangs nges par bshad pa la/ phyi ma'i phyogs 'dzin dag spyir shing rta'i srol 'byed yin min drang nges 'byed pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin min gyi sgo nas 'jog dgos te/spyir shing rta'i srol 'byed theg chen gyi grub mtha' smra ba'i dbang du byas la/ der dbu sems kyi srol gnyis las phung gsum pa med cing / de gnyis kyi khyad par rgya che ba'i shing rta'i srol phye pas mi 'byed pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ de ltar na srol 'byed gzhi ni lugs de gnyis kyi zab mo lta ba'i gnad las ma 'das pas shing rta'i srol 'byed ni drang nges la shing rta'i srol 'byed yin min gyis 'jog par grub pa'i phyir/ma khyab mtshams kyi rtags grub ste/ grub mtha' rtsa bar/ phal cher rgya che'i lam mthun zab la min/ /zhes dang / lcang skya'i grub mthar/ dbu sems kyi shing rta'i srol chen po 'di gnyis la bden pa bzhi dang rten 'brel bcu gnyis la sogs pa theg pa dman pa'i lam gyi rim pa'i nyams len dang / theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la yang spyod pa'i rten sems bskyed pa dang / nas/ phal cher mtshungs/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na grub mtha' smra ba gang rung zhig gi shing rta'i srol 'byed yin na shing rta'i srol 'byed yin dgos pas shing rta'i srol 'byed la mang po yod kyang drang nges 'byed pa'i de la gnyis su grangs nges par khas blang kyang gnod byed mi rnyed pa'i phyir/ des na dbu sems gang rung gi shing rta'i srol 'byed yin na shing rta'i srol 'byed yin pas khyab la/ thal rang sogs la de ltar ma khyab pa'ang gnad 'di la thug pa yin no zhes zer ba la/ snga mas de 'dra'i skyon med de/ grub mtha' smra ba gang yang rung ba zhig gi shing rta'i srol 'byed yin na mi'i sha tshugs can gyi 'grel byed gzhan la ma brten nga sa khyab pa 34

med pa'i phyir zhes/ skyon spong byed do/ /phar phyin mtha' dpyod du dbu ma ba'i sbas don mngon rtogs dngos po brgyad du 'grel ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la rgyan rtsom pa po bzhag par/ gzhan dag na re/ de chos can/ khyod sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed kyang yin : par thal/ khyod kyis sbas don mngon rtogs kyi srol phye ba gang / dbu sems kyi rgya che ba'i lam gyi lus rag pa la khyad par med pa'i phyir zer na brtag go/ kho na re/ rgyan rtsom pa po rgya che ba'i shing rta'i srol 'byed ma yin par thal/ thogs med de yin pa'i phyir te/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ shing rta chen po gnyis las legs brgyud pa'i/ /zab mo lta ba rgya chen spyod pa'i lam/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de'i don ni spyir de gnyis shing rta chen po yin pa dang zab rgyas gnyis de dag las brgyud pa'i dbang du byas pa las/ de gnyis shing rta chen por 'jog byed zab rgyas kyi shing rta'i srol gnyis phye ba la byed pa'i don ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lcang skya'i grub mthar/ 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas par phyin du shing rta'i srol 'byed la gsum du gsungs pa sngon gyi mkhas pa'i khas len gyi rting mnan pa tsam las rang gi bzhed pa dngos ni shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis su nges pa grub mtha'i bshad lugs kyis shes par gsungs kyang / grub mtha' las/ des na slob dpon klu sgrub dang thogs med 'di gnyis kyis gtso bor dbu sems kyi shing rta'i srol phye zhing / zhar la theg dman gyi mdo'i dbongs pa'ang dbu sems kyi lugs su bkral ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar de gnyis kyis dbu sems kyi shing rta'i srol phye bar gsungs pa las shing rta'i srol 'byed la gnyis su grangs nges par bzhed pa'i bshad lugs mi snang ngo / /stong thun las/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis rtsa she'i 'grel ba mdzad nas 'phags pa yab sras kyi dgongs pa thal 'gyur du bkral/ ces gsungs pa la brten nas/ yab rje skal ldan rgya mtshos/ thal 'gyur shing rta'i srol 'byed sangs rgyas bskyangs/ /zhes gsungs shing / rgyal rong bstan dar/ kun mkhyen bla ma/ byang rtse sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs kyis kyang de ltar bzhed do/ /de la kha cig de mi 'thad de/ stong thun gyi lung don/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur pa'i srol klu sgrub las gsal tsam phye ba ma gtogs/ de thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du bzhed pa min zhing / thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed la zla grags 'jog pa gzhung 'di shin tu gsal ba dang / srol phye ba tsam la byed na/ byams mgon sems tsam dang / klu sgrub thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du ha cang thal ba'i phyir zhes zer ro/ /sbyin pa dar rgyas kyis/ sangs rgyas bskyangs dang zla ba gnyis ka thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i sro pa 'byed du bshad pa la/ kha cig sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis phye zin na zla bas slar 'byed dgos don med la/ ma phye na de thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du 'dod pa nyams pa'i phyir/gzhan yang / kho rang la/ de ba sharma dang legs ldan gnyis ka rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin 35

par thal/ de gnyis gas rang rgyud pa'i srol phye bar khyod kyis kyang bshad pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur pa'i srol phye bas de de'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du bzhag pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum zer na brtag go/ par phyin mtha' dpyod du sangs rgyas bskyangs thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du bzhag nas/ zla grags shing rta'i srol 'byed du bshad pa'i gzhung sngar drangs pa'i don 'grel ba na/ de la kho na re/ 'di'i dbu ma bas rang rgyud bya mi rigs pa'i sgrub byed dang / ldog phyogs rang rgyud la gnod byed mang du ston mkhan sangs rgyas bskyangs yin par thal/ shing rta'i srol phye la zhes pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan sangs rgyas bskyangs yin pa'i phyir na/ ma khyab ste/ sgrub byed dang gnod byed ston mkhan zla grags yin yang sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol phye ba'i phyir/zhes lung gi stod smad dum bur bcad nas sgrub byed dang gnod byed ston mkhan dang shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan la gang zag so so ba gnyis bzhag pa ni 'brel med du mkhas pa mang po zhal 'cham mo/ /lcang skya'i grub mthar/ kun mkhyen bla mas sangs rgyas bskyangs thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du bzhag pa'ang snga ma'i gsung dang bstun pa las rang lugs la zla grags thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du bzhed pa/grub mtha' rtsa bar/ zla bas legs bkag thun mong min par bsgrubs/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis shes par gsungs kyang / der ni/ rtsa ba sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur pakral/ /ces pa rtsa 'grel gyis sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol phye ba dang / zla bas legs bkag thun mong min par bsgrubs/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis zla bas rang phyogs la sgrub byed dang / ldog phyogs la gnod byed bstan par bzhed snang bas phar phyin mtha' dpyod kyi bshad tshul las bshad tshul gnyis pa zhig min nam snyam mo/ /theg dman gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed yod med dang / yod na gang la ngos 'dzin pa dang /rnam bden rdzun gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed dang / bod kyi grub mtha' so so'i shing rta'i srol 'byed sogs dpyad bya ha cang mang yang ma spros so//gsum/ shing rta'i srol 'dzin 'phags pa lha dang dbyig gnyen sogs la mchod par brjod pa/shing rta chen po'i zhes sogs byung / shing rta chen po'i lam srol gnyis legs par bzung ba'i sgo nas/'dzam gling 'dir dbu sems so so'i blo gsal bye ba ste grangs med pa'i rgyud la gsung rab kyi don shing rta chen po gnyis kyis so sor bkral ba ltar rtorges pa'i shes rab kyi mig 'byed par byed pa'i shing rta'i srol 'dzin gyi parnyi ta 'phags pa lha sogs klu sgrub kyi rjes 'brang dang / dbyig gnyen sogs thogs med kyi rjes 'brang mtshan dngos su thon pa dang / ma thon pa zhi ba lhas mtshon pa'i dbu ma dang / shārnyi bas mtshon pa'i rnam rig pa'i srol 'dzin 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur cing thub bstan rin po che bshad 36

phyir/ 'khor gsum zer na brtag go/ par phyin mtha' dpyod du sangs rgyas bskyangs thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed du bzhag nas/ zla grags shing rta'i srol 'byed du bshad pa'i gzhung sngar drangs pa'i don 'grel ba na/ de la kho na re/ 'di'i dbu ma bas rang rgyud bya mi rigs pa'i sgrub byed dang / ldog phyogs rang rgyud la gnod byed mang du ston mkhan sangs rgyas bskyangs yin par thal/ shing sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur pakral/ /ces pa rtsa 'grel gyis sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol phye ba dang / zla bas legs bkag thun mong min par bsgrubs/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel gyis zla bas rang phyogs la sgrub byed dang / ldog phyogs la gnod byed bstan par bzhed snang bas phar phyin mtha' dpyod kyi bshad tshul las bshad tshul gnyis pa zhig min nam snyam mo/ /theg 'byed par byed pa'i shing rta'i srol 'dzin gyi parnyi ta 'phags pa lha sogs klu sgrub kyi rjes 'brang dang / dbyig gnyen sogs thogs med kyi rjes 'brang mtshan dngos su thon pa dang / ma thon pa zhi ba lhas mtshon pa'i dbu ma dang / shārnyi bas mtshon pa'i rnam rig pa'i srol 'dzin 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan du gyur cing thub bstan rin po che bshad 36

sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams la gus pa chen pos 'dud pa'o/ /de yang 'phags pa lha ni gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma ba ste des ye shes snying po kun btus/ 'khrul ba zlog pa'i gtan tshigs sgrub pa/ dbu ma lag pa'i tshad sogs dang / brjod bya yongs su rdzogs pa rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi pargya ba mdzad nas klu sgrub kyi srol bzung ba dang / dpa' bos skyes rabs dang / bstod tshogs sogs mang po dang / dbu ma'i gzhang yang phar phyin bsdus pa sogs du ma mdzad na'ang / dbu ma'i gzhung che ba rnams bod la ma phebs par rjes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos phal cher bod du ma phebs kyang / gtso bo 'grel ba buddha pā li ta mdzad nas thal 'gyur pa'i srol phye zhing / legs ldan gyis dbu ma'i lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad rgyas par ston pa dbu ma snying po dang de'i 'grel ba rtog ge 'bar ba/ rtsa she'i 'grel ba shes rab sgron me rnams mdzad nas rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol phye ba yin no/ /zla ba grags pas rtsa she'i sgos 'grel du tshig gsal dang / rtsa sher zab rgyas gnyis tshogs kyi sgo nas 'jug pa dbu ma 'jug pa rtsa 'grel mdzad de thal 'gyur pa'i shing rta'i srol phye nas 'phags pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug phyin ci ma log par gsal bar mdzad pa ste de dag ni shing rta chen po klu sgrub kyi srol 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mkhas grub chen po dag go/ dbyig gnyen gyis theg pa che chung gi gzhung mang du mdzad pa las/ pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad dang / mdo 'grel skor gsum sogs kyi skabs dang / blo gros brtan pas mdo sde rgyan dang dbus mtha' gnyis kyi 'grel bshad/ phung po lnga'i rab byed dang sum cu ba gnyis kyi 'grel ba sogs dang / phyogs glang gis brgyad stong don bsdus dang tshad ma kun btus sogs dang / chos grags kyis tshad ma sde bdun sogs mdzad nas thogs med kyis phye ba'i lam srol bskyangs pa ste de dag ni shing rta chen po thogs med kyi srol 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mkhas grub dag go/ 'dir 'phags pa lha rdzus skyes yin min dang / zla bas klu sgrub kyi zhabs zin ma zin dang / de byon dus sogs dpyad bya mang yang ma spros so// gnyis pa/ rtsom par dam bca' ba/gnyis pa rtsom par dam bca' ba ni/ gzhung lugs mang thos zhes sogs byung / de la rkang pa dang po bzhis gsung rab la drang nges 'byed tshul rtogs dka' bas bod snga ma rnams kyis ji bzhin ma rtogs par bstan nas/ rkang pa tha ma gnyis kyis rjes 'jam dbyangs kyi man ngag la bsten nas ji bzhin rtogs te brtse ba chen pos 'chad par dam bca' ba ste/ de yang rngog bu sogs gzhung lugs mang du thos pa 37

dang / seng chen brgyad sogs mang du thos par ma zad rigs pa'i lam du yang ngal ba mang po bsten pa dang / dol bo ba sogs mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs kyis mi dman pa zhes brag sgo phun tshogs rgya mtsho sogs kyis sbyar ba ltar ram/ gzhan phal cher gyi gsungs tshul ltar na/ mdo sngags rig gnas sogs mang du thos pa dang / rigs pa'i lam la sbyangs pa mang du mdzad pa dang / spyod phyogs kyi rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis mi dman pa du mas kyang rtsol ba mang du bsten na yang rtogs par ma gyur pa'i zab mo'i gnas de ni 'jam mgon bla ma ste 'jam pa'i dbyangs bshes gnyen du bzung zhing gsung gi bdud rtsi ngoms med du bzhes pa'i drin gyis legs par te phyin ci ma log par gzigs nas/ rjes 'jug rnams la thugs shin tu brtse ba'i bsam pas bdag gis bshad par bya'o zhes dam bca' mdzad pa ste/ 'jam mgon bla ma'i bka' drin gyis legs par mthong ba'i tshul ni/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis khyod la mngon sum du/ /nyin re bzhin yang legs bshad bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi bcud bsdus pa/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'doms zhes dang / gsang rnam tshigs bcad mar/ rab mdzes 'od zer lnga yi dra ba can/ /shin tu zlum pa'i dbus su 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mngon sum gzigs pa rgyal sras chos kyi rje/ /zhes dang / de nas brtsams te rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter/ /nam 'dod gzigs shing dpal ldan 'dus pa dang / /shes rab pha rol phyin gzhung zab mo'i don/ /rgyun du gsan pa rgyal sras chos kyi rje/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ gzhung 'di mdzad pa na'ang / rnam thar zur rgyan las/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis dbu sems kyi grub mtha'i gnad rnams gsungs nas/ da ni 'di rnams kyi don bsdus pa zhig yi ger gyis gsungs pa la brten nas drang nges rnam 'byed brtsams pa yin/ zhes dang / gzhung 'di'i mjug rtsom du yang gsal ba ltar la/ sman lung rgya sog phur 'jam dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang sems dang paṇa grub mang bos bskor ba gzigs pa/ de dag gi gzhung la brten nas phan thogs rgya chen 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du gsungs pa'i nang tshan dbu sems kyi drang nges kyi srol 'byed dang srol 'dzin mang po'i gzhung la brten nas phan pa rgya chen 'byung ba ni gzhung 'di la brten nas yin par dam pa dag gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mchod brjod kyis bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu tshogs slob dpon snga ma'i man ngag dang ldan tshul dang / rtsom par dam bcas nang gi don rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan tshul gnyis tshang bar bstan pa dang / yang rtsom par dam bcas gsung rab kyi dgongs pa ma nor bar gzigs pa'i mkhyen rab phun tshogs dang / gdul bya la rjes su brtse ba'i brtse ba phun tshogs gnyis tshang bar bstan pa yin no// 38

gsum pa/ snod ldan nyan par bskul ba/gsum pa snod ldan nyan par bskul ba ni/ bstan pa'i de nyid ces sogs byung / mdo sngags kyi lam gang gis bla med byang chub sgrub kyang gang gtan la phab nas nyams su/ len pa las 'dar mi rung ba ni bstan pa'i de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod de de rgyud la bskyed nas 'bras bu smra ba zla med kyi go 'phang 'dod pa'i skal bzang rnams gus pa chen pos nyon ces bskul ba ste/ snga phyi bsdoms pas dgos sogs chos bzhi pastan tshul ni/ gnas de ni zhes pa yan gyis brjod bya zab mo'i de kho na nyid de 'di'i brjod bya dang / bstan pa'i de nyid rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod ces pas 'di la brten nas zab don rtogs pa'i shes rab skyed pa gnas skabs kyi dgos pa dang / smra ba zla med ces pas 'di la brten nas zab mo'i lam nyid rgya che ba'i lam dang sbrel nas nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang nying dgos dang /nying dgos de nyid stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i lam dang 'brel ba dang / lam nyid brjod bya de kho na nyid ston pa dang 'brel ba ni 'brel ba'i tshul te shugs la thon pa yin no/ /'brel ba la gzhan sdes sna tshogs smra yang rang lugs la bdag gcig 'brel dang rten byung 'brel gnyis su grangs nges shing 'di'i 'brel ba ni phyi ma yin la/ de yang 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya'i thob bya stong nyid rtogs pa'i mthar thug gi ye shes de nyid rang rgyu stong nyid rtogs pa'i lam la brten nas byung / lam de nyid 'di'i brjod bya'i stong pa nyid bstan bcos kyis drang nges phye nas bshad pa la brten nas byung ba yin no/ /bden tshig kun la chos bzhi partsir rung zhing / dgos 'brel gyi dbang du byas na/ bstan bcos lus kyi chos bzhi parjod bya/ ngag las rtog ldan la go ba'am the tshom skye ba dgos pa/ de las bstan bcos la 'jug pa nying dgos/ de dag snga ma med na phyi ma mi 'byung ba 'brel ba yin zhing / rtog ldan bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i gegs bzhi sel tshul dang / de'i yan lag la chos bzhi las mang mi dgos shing nyung mi rung ba'i tshul sogs gser phreng las shes par bya'o//spro na/ de la kho na re/ 'di'i dgos pa dang brjod bya gnyis rten byung 'brel ma yin par thal/'di'i brjod bya la stong nyid dang / nying dgos la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyang yod pa gang zhig myang 'das de de kho na nyid rtogs pa dang / de stong nyid dang rten byung 'brel du 'gyur tshul med pa'i phyir na ma khyab cing/ 'di'i nying dgos la nying dgos mthar thug gis ma khyab pa dang / spyir rnam mkhyen dang ngo bo nyid sku sogs 'di'i nying dgos la mi 'jog pa dang bstan bcos kyi 'brel ba la dgos sogs bzhi'i 39

nang gi 'brel bas khyab ma khyab dang / de la rten byung 'brel yin dgos mi dgos dang / 'di'i ched du bya ba'i gdul byas thob pa'i rnam mkhyen kho kho rang yin min sogs la'ang spro bya mang ngo / /dgos 'brel ngag klad du bkod pa'i dgos pa la/ ku mā ri la la sogs pas dgos 'brel ngag la brten nas chos bzhi yod pa tshad mas nges nas bstan bcos la 'jug pa dang / zhi 'tsho'i bden gnyis dka' 'grel du bstan bcos rtsom pa'i skabs 'gog pa zlog pa dang / bram ze bde byed dga' ba dang g.yag phrug pas gzhung gi yi ge mdzes pa dang / chos mchog gis don mi 'gyur gyi dogs pa bzhi pasal nas don 'gyur gyi the tshom bzhi skyed pa bshad pa rnams 'thad mi 'thad kyi khyad par gser phreng las shes par bya la/ par phyin mtha' dpyod du bu ston gyis lugs dang po ltar bzhed par gsungs kyang lung snyer de bkag go/ rang lugs ni gser phreng las/ ngag 'dis ji ltar dam bcas pa ltar bstan bcos la zhugs te yod med brtags la yod na ni 'jug cing med na ni ldog par bya'o snyam du bsams nas 'jug par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gdul bya 'jug pa'i yan lag tu dgos 'brel ngag thog mar bkod pa yin no/ /de la 'di'i dgos pa dang nying dgos gnyis 'di la brten nas 'ong dgos pas chos bzhi pastan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag tu mi 'thad cing / 'di'i brjod bya rtogs pa la stong nyid rtogs dgos shing de 'di la zhugs 'bras su 'byung dgos pas chos bzhi rtogs pa'ang der mi rung la/ dgos 'brel gyi ngag thos pa tsam gyis dbang rnon bstan bcos la mi 'jug pas dgos 'brel gyi ngag thos pa'ang der mi rung ngo / /des na chos bzhi la go ba yang dag gam don 'gyur gyi the tshom ni bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag yin te/de'i sgo nas gdul bya bstan bcos la 'jug par byeng pa'i phyir/ tshad ma brtag pa las/ gang phyir don gnyer 'jig rten 'di/ /the tshom las kyang 'jug phyir ro/ /zhes dang / be'u bum sngon po las/ don 'gyur don mi 'gyur pa dag la/ /the tshom zana'ang 'jug ldog rgyur gsungs/ /zhes dang / gser phreng las/ de bzhi phal cher yod las che snyam pa'i don 'gyur gyi the tshom bzhi paskyed de rtog ldan bstan bcos la 'jug ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ lung dang po 'di gser phreng du khungs gsal bar ma mdzad la lung snyer dbyig gnyen gyi gsung dang / phar phyin mtha' dpyod sogs su 'thad ldan gyi yin par byas kyang gzhung mang por tshad ma brtag pa'i yin par gsungs pa ltar gzhung der snang ngo / /phar phyin mtha' dpyod du gdul bya dbang rnon the tshom las rgyan la 'jug pa'i shes byed du drangs pa ltar na des dbang rnon gyi 'jug tshul dang / dbu ma rgyan zin du rang sde dbang rtul shin lkog la 'jug pa na lung tsam sgrub byed du byas nas 'jug pa'i shes byed du drangs pa ltar na des dbang rtul gyi 'jug tshul bstan par snang ba dang / 40

tshad ma brtag pa'i lung 'di dang rgyud bla dar ṭīka la brten nas dbang rnon the tshom dang rgyu mtshan yang dag mthong ba gang gi sgo nas bstan bcos la 'jug dpyad tshul so gas drang nges dogs dpyod du 'byung zhing /der/ grub mtha' rtsa bar/ yul mchog bstan kyang yul can mchog sbas bzhin/ /zhes sogs la brten nas gzhung 'dir sngags lam yongs rdzogs bstan ma bstan gyi dogs pa bkod kyang / grub mtha' rtsa bas mdo phyogs su sngags lam sbas pa ma gtogs sbas te bstan par gsungs pa min par mngon no/ /the tshom bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur tshul ni/ dgos 'brel ngag gis bstan bcos lus la chos bzhi yod par dam bcas pa na rtog ldan la der de yod med the tshom skye zhing de las chos bzhi yod med lta la yod na 'jug par bya'o snyam du bstan bcos la 'jug par gser phreng las gsungs so/ /de lta na'ang dgos 'brel mchod brjod kyi sngon du ma bkod pa ni de'i sngon du bkod na tshul dang mi mthun pa dang /mchod brjod kyis dang ba skyed la/ des bstan bcos la 'jug par phyogs pa na chos bzhi la rtog pas mchod brjod kyi 'og tu dgos 'brel ngag bkod pa chos bshes 'chad pa ltar rjes kyang bzhed do// sa bcad gnyis pa/bcoms pa'i bstan bcos kyi lus dngos bshad pa/ gnyis pa brtsams pa'i bstan bcos kyi lus dngos bshad pa la gsum/ gsung rab kyi drang nges 'byed pa gal che bar bstan pa/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab la drang nges rgyas par phye ba/ rang nyid gang gi rjes su 'brang bstan cing mjug bsdu ba'o//dang po/ gsung rab kyi drang nges 'byed pa gal che bar bstan pa/dang po gsung rab kyi drang nges 'byed pa gal che bar bstan pa la gsum/ thar pa thob pa la yul rnam thar sgo gsum gyis bsdus pa'i stong nyid rtogs dgos pa dang / de lta bu'i stong nyid rtogs pa la rgyal ba'i gsung rab kyi drang nges 'byed dgos pa dang / de nyid kyi shes byed mdo dang sbyar ba'o// 41

gcig thar ba thob pa la yul rnam thar sgo gsum gyis bsdus pa'i stong nyid rtogs dgos pa/dang po ni/ ji skad du/ zhes sogs byung / dkon brtsegs kyi yul 'khor skyong zhus su myu gu lta bu rang gi ngo bo bden pas stong ba ni stong ba nyid dang / de'i rgyu bden pas stong ba'am de don dam par rgyu las skyes pas stong ba ni zhi ba ste mtshan ma med pa dang / de'i 'bras bu bden pas stong ba'am des don dam par rang 'bras skyed pas stong ba ni skye ba med pa ste smon pa med pa'i rnam thar gsum gyi tshul mi shes pas bdag 'dzin gnyis kyi zhen yul sun 'byin mi nus la/ de ma nus pas bdag 'dzin gyi dbang du song ste las sna tshogs bsags nas 'khor bar 'khyam par 'gyur pa gzigs nas/ 'gro ba de dag ston pa thugs rje mnga' bas mdzad pa bcu gnyis spyi dang khyad par chos dang yang sgos rags pa'i bdag med ston pa sogs stong nyid las brtsams pa'i chos sgo mang po ston pa'i thabs tshul dang / rten 'brel sogs dri ma med pa'i rigs pa brgya dag ste dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas yul rnam thar sgo gsum khong du chud pa la 'dzud par mdzad do/ /zhes pa ste phyi 'grel don des rtogs nus so// 'dir/ rnam thar sgo gsum la/nyan thos sde ba'i gzhung mdzod du bden bzhi'i rnam pas bzhag pa dang / rnam rig pa'i gzhung mdo sde rgyan le'u bco lnga par mthong lam gyi dmigs pa dag pas dang / de dang phyogs mthun par le'u bcu dgu par bdag med gzhan dbang myang 'das gsum gyis dang / chos kyi sdom bzhis bzhag pa dngu / dbus mthar gnyen po gsum gyis bzhag pa dang / sa'i dngos gzhir stong nyid bzhi sogs yul gyis bzhag pa dang / byang sar bdag med gzhan dbang myang 'das gsum gyis bzhag pa dang / nyan sar 'khor ba myang 'das bdag med gsum gyis bzhag pa dang / kun btus su bden bzhi'i rnam pas bzhag pa dang /bsdu bar mtshan nyid gsum gyis dang / gnyen po gsum gyis dang / rgyu mtshan sogs chos lngas dang /bden pa gsum gyi rnam
